market_outlook.short_term: Markets face a volatile 1-3 month window: Sept 16 Fed decision is the pivotal catalyst. Diesel at all-time high and Iran escalation keep energy inflation elevated, limiting Fed's ability to cut. Expect Dow futures weakness into the week. AI names (NVDA, CRM, CRWD, OKTA) provide selective upside but concentration risk caps broad rallies. Canada trade retaliation adds a new drag. Crypto remains choppy with liquidity concerns. Net: range-bound with downside skew on geopolitical headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook is constructive for AI infrastructure, energy, and EM but conditional. NVDA's year-ahead forecast validates multi-year AI capex cycle. On-device AI (Apple) diversifies demand. Energy inflation normalizes if Iran de-escalates. Consumer recovery depends on wage-inflation gap closing. Bond market restructuring (hyperscaler bonds vs. Treasuries) will reshape fixed-income allocations. EM rotation is a 12-month theme. Key risk: if Fed is forced to hike, growth multiple compression could offset earnings strength.
